decision.target: R1-P as an independent new-algorithm research candidate only
decision.meaning: Not retained as an independent research candidate; not whole-research CLOSED or a mathematical NO_GO.
decision.status_convention: Reuse the existing NOT_ADOPTED management identifier (documented in prior research records); new scoped additive decision record, not a new global status schema.
approved_reasons: Under A+ positive local-term grouping/refinement with the same J accounting, the fixed evidence records a direct reduction using known commutator/leakage bounds, finite BCH truncation and Duhamel.
No basis remains in that scope for retaining an independent new construction principle or mathematical guarantee as a research result.
Ordinary fourth-order PF has a finite-step low-energy guarantee under the same information; R1-P alone establishes no total absolute-E0 resource advantage.
Do not perform the four-orbital two-electron check; it is unlikely to change the present independence decision.
limits: No judgment of R1-P truth or falsity for arbitrary fragment decompositions.
No resolution of general low-energy extrapolated-PF guarantees.
No general impossibility of new guarantees.
No assertion extrapolated PF is always costlier than ordinary fourth-order PF.
No independent certification by detailed scientific review.
decision.reconsideration: A substantively different unresolved mathematical problem, lawful input/locality/J accounting outside the known reduction, or independent guarantee/total-cost difference versus an equally informed strong baseline; renaming or changing fragments, coefficients or constants alone is insufficient. GPT/user judgment and separate authorization required; no automatic restart.
